# Reconciled Remaining Work

The Awtsmoos renews every unfinished route before the next edit has a name; Awtsmoos.com therefore keeps the ledger alive, so no success becomes a veil over what still must shine.

## Corrected evidence

- Social Hub passed the static isolation gate across its active CSS graph.
- Home was migrated to explicit `data-geelooy-route="home"` contracts and route-local style modules.
- The previous search for `geelooy/style/tf.css` was pointed at the wrong filesystem root. The URL `/style/tf.css` resolves from the repository origin root, so the correct candidate is `style/tf.css`.
- Home currently does not include `/style/tf.css`; its shared component contract must be inspected before restoration.
- Home's final static audit still needs to run against the current import graph after the cache-generation rewrite.
- Docs and Drive have not yet received this continuation wave.
- Runtime browser verification remains partially blocked by native Chrome adapter return-shape limitations.
- Procedural-core promotion remains a parallel unfinished mission.

## REMAINING_WORK

- [ ] Inspect `style/tf.css` and its transitive graph; classify component-rooted vs truly global selectors.
- [ ] Restore `/style/tf.css` to Home only if the component contract is safe and required.
- [ ] Run Home zero-leak / zero-oversize / zero-foreign-z / tab-indentation audit.
- [ ] Re-read Home touched files after final restoration.
- [ ] Audit Docs entrypoint, active CSS graph, JS selector contracts, z-index, overflow, disclosure, and file sizes.
- [ ] Rewrite Docs only where evidence proves debt; split oversized responsibilities rather than compressing them.
- [ ] Audit Drive entrypoint, active CSS graph, JS selectors, pane/scroll ownership, dialogs, context menus, and file sizes.
- [ ] Rewrite Drive only where evidence proves debt; make narrow-screen pane retraction explicit.
- [ ] Continue route-family migration: authoring, Heichel, profile/social, auth/account, media/messages, games, OS/admin/tools, utilities, legal/informational.
- [ ] Continue JS/API architecture audits where UI work reveals runtime debt.
- [ ] Continue procedural-core promotion and testing.
- [ ] Update durable docs and handoff after verified implementation.

## NEXT_ACTION

Inspect the origin-root shared component stylesheet `style/tf.css`, then close Home's final integration gate before entering Docs.
